note: The single-region runtime admits TiKV leader-only access and explicitly rejects follower, mixed, learner, stale, and proxy routes. TiFlash and the broader access-mode index remain external.
An injected loader supplies already-decoded region metadata at the cache-miss boundary. Concrete PD networking, API-v1 key encoding, keyspace-v2 codecs, scans, and split RPCs remain external.

Ordered single-region key lookup, injected-loader miss fill, exact-version invalidation, transactional intersecting replacement, cross-ID stale-overlap rejection, and half-open containment execute. TTL, buckets, batch scans, background refresh, multi-region splitting, and PD networking remain external.

One validated leader route canonicalizes policy-owned protobuf flags, attaches exact region, epoch, peer role, witness flag, and cluster identity immediately before one injected address call, and preserves the direct-unary client's typed error. Retries, backoff, cancellation, region errors, locks, metrics, async dispatch, and forwarding remain external.

The PD-declared leader is selected only when peer, store, address, and captured store epoch agree. Follower, mixed, learner, stale, prefer-leader, and proxy policies explicitly fail closed; their routing strategies, busy scoring, and retries remain external.
The bounded selector never consults slow scores because it admits only an exact leader route. Sliding windows, health scoring, and busy fallback remain external.

A sorted region vector preserves source key order, half-open containment, and the pre-delete stale-overlap guard that protects newer split children from stale parents. B-tree concurrency, TTL traversal, batch ascent, and benchmarks remain external.

Immutable store ID, address, and resolve epoch are checked against the epoch captured by the region peer. PD store loading, state transitions, liveness, health feedback, TLS probes, and background refresh remain external.
